answer: Escrow referral stops mass fakes. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, filing a marble plate with its referrer. The graph hangs on a terrace, open to all. One referrer's hundreds form a star, an ocean of accounts from one source. Peers dispute rented referrals: a confirmed fake loses its bond to the disputer. Each fake pays 40, locks 70; 1,000 fakes pay 40,000, risk 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once, pay 40, keep their share.
